packets.gold_conclusion: The represented dose > 5 predicate survives the specificity contrast; that structural pass does not by itself prove causality.
critical_semantics: Harbor and Lark are positive/response cases; Juniper is tolerated control.
Sable is present in all three cases.
Represented Sable dose is Harbor=10, Lark=12, Juniper=1 units.
The tested predicate is Sable dose > 5.
Dose is a separate source-grounded modifier distinction.

packets.gold_conclusion: The proposed minimum-threshold hypothesis predicts the opposite dose direction and cannot receive definitive support without a separately supported exception mechanism.
critical_semantics: Plover is positive; Kestrel is tolerated control.
Observed represented exposure is 0.1 units and is high-information.
Material hypothesis requires exposure >= 10 units.

packets.gold_conclusion: Without a tolerated or negative comparator, discrimination is insufficiently established; do not convert the absence of a control into either a pass or a fail.
critical_semantics: Aspen and Kivu are positive/response cases.
Sol is present in both.
No tolerated or negative control exists.
Task is discrimination, not mere association.

packets.gold_conclusion: The onset qualifier is source-explicit and must be preserved and marked high-information in the state. If it is omitted, count a semantic representation error, not a deterministic-verifier failure.
critical_semantics: The source states onset is within 2 seconds.
Onset/timing must be represented as a qualifier rather than dropped.
The onset qualifier must be marked high-information.
An omitted onset is a semantic representation failure and is not attributed to the deterministic verifier.

packets.gold_conclusion: The proposed delayed-onset hypothesis predicts the opposite timing direction and cannot receive definitive support without a separately supported exception mechanism.
critical_semantics: Alder is positive; Basin is tolerated control.
Observed onset is within 2 seconds and is high-information.
Material hypothesis requires onset no sooner than 3600 seconds.

packets.gold_conclusion: The feature survives the represented specificity contrast, but specificity alone is not proof of causality.
critical_semantics: Oriel and Rowan are positive/response cases; Silt is tolerated control.
Nimbus is present in Oriel and Rowan.
Nimbus is absent from Silt.
Task is only whether Nimbus survives specificity; specificity is not causal proof.

packets.gold_conclusion: The shared marker alone does not discriminate the responsive cases from the tolerated control, so it cannot support a definitive selective-explanation conclusion.
critical_semantics: Cedar and Flint are positive/response cases; Mica is tolerated and non-reactive.
Vela is present in Cedar, Flint, and Mica.
Task tests Vela itself as explanation for selective response.

packets.gold_conclusion: Evidence only about the adjacent mechanism/pathway target cannot establish the requested harm/risk target.
critical_semantics: Requested target is adverse_outcome_risk.
Available evidence establishes only adjacent target pathway_activity.
No observation is bound to adverse_outcome_risk.
The proposed adverse_outcome_risk conclusion depends only on pathway_activity evidence.
